title: LGTM: Less Gaussians, Texture More for 3D Reconstruction
summary: A 3D reconstruction framework that utilizes compact textured Gaussian primitives to decouple geometric complexity from rendering resolution. It enables high-fidelity 4K feed-forward synthesis without the need for per-scene optimization.
research_notes: A collaboration between The University of Hong Kong and Apple; notably the first method to achieve native 4K feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

evolution.summary: Following its initial publication, the official code and weights were released under Apple's machine learning repository in early 2026. It has since been adopted as a plug-and-play high-resolution rendering module for generalizable backbones like NoPoSplat and DepthSplat.
